heroIntro: I work with governments, corporates and development partners to turn a failing outcome into a system they can fund and build: the research, the architecture, the business model and the regulatory pathway.
primaryCtaNote: Free 15-minute initial consult · no preparation needed
bookingText: We start with a free 15-minute initial conversation. If you want to go further, you then book a full 60-minute exploration call at $250.
bioHeading: Kezah Kayitesi is a venture and business architect based in Kigali, Rwanda.
bioShort: She works with governments, corporates, development partners and founders to move from the people a system is failing to a Solutions Manual a team can fund and build.
metaDescription: Kezah Kayitesi is a venture and business architect in Kigali. She designs the systems that make Africa's blind spots measurable, and fixable.
offersHeading: Four ways to work with me, from first question to a team that builds.
offersCta: Not sure which one fits? Start with a free 15-minute consult.
workHeading: Systems I have architected, each stated exactly as it stands.
methodHeading: Pains to Systems. It starts with the people a system is failing.
methodIntro: Six stages. What you receive at the Blueprint stage is the Solutions Manual. It is how a client gets there, never the point.
whyHeading: I design the rails that level the odds, because access, not ability, decides most lives.
whyIntro: I grew up in Kenya as a refugee of the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi. I lived uptown; many of my cousins did not. Same family, different odds, and the difference was access. Every line below is a person, and the system built for them.
writingIntro: A look into my mind outside work. Articles, essays and poems, monthly.
contactHeading: Tell me what is failing. We will find out why.

methodStages.name: Explore
methodStages.what: Discovery calls to understand the client's needs and ideal outcome.
methodStages.out: A shared definition of the problem and success.

methodStages.name: Research
methodStages.out: Evidence of the root cause and where data is missing.

methodStages.name: Design
methodStages.what: Three to four concept sprints, co-created with the client at two levels for alignment.

methodStages.name: Blueprint
methodStages.what: Building the documentation the problem needs.
methodStages.out: The Solutions Manual: concept note, slides, legal blueprint, FRD, system design.

methodStages.name: Submit
methodStages.out: A handover ready for funding or approval.

methodStages.name: Assemble (optional)
methodStages.what: Curating the execution team for the sector.
